jei.chunkdeeds.claim_deed.info: Craft with Paper and 1 to 8 Diamonds. Each Diamond adds extra Chunk Claims to the Deed. Right-click the Deed in hand to redeem it and expand your FTB Chunks claim limit. You can also upgrade existing Deeds in the crafting table by adding more Diamonds!
jei.chunkdeeds.forceload_deed.info: Craft with Paper and 1 to 8 Netherite Scraps. Each Scrap adds extra Force-Loaded Chunks to the Deed. Right-click the Deed in hand to redeem it and expand your FTB Chunks force-load limit. You can also upgrade existing Deeds in the crafting table by adding more Netherite Scraps!
